title: Delhi Sultanate
examples: What were the different groups that ruled Delhi?
How did the Sultanate manage its government?
Can you tell me about the different dynasties in Delhi?

explain.say: The Delhi Sultanate was ruled by several different dynasties over time.
The Mamluk Dynasty was one of the earliest groups to rule Delhi.
The Khilji Dynasty is known for some strong rulers and changes.
Administration involved collecting taxes and managing the land resources.
The central government managed large armies and appointed officials to provinces.
In real life, managing a large school requires many different roles.

faq.q: What did the word 'dynasty' mean in this period?
faq.a: A dynasty refers to a family or line of rulers that maintains power over a long period.
asks: What was the ruling family called?
How long did one group rule?

faq.q: How did the Sultanate collect money from the people?
faq.a: They collected taxes on land and goods from the people living in the Sultanate's areas.
asks: What was the tax system like?
Who was responsible for the taxes?

faq.q: Were all the dynasties equally powerful?
faq.a: No, the power and influence of the dynasties changed over the centuries.

faq.q: What was the job of the administrators?
faq.a: Administrators were responsible for running the day-to-day affairs of the large kingdom.

faq.q: Did the rulers change the laws often?
faq.a: The laws and administrative rules could change significantly depending on the ruling dynasty.

facts: The Delhi Sultanate was not ruled by a single family for its entire period.
Administration involved maintaining large armies and collecting revenue.
The Mamluk Dynasty was one of the earliest ruling groups.
Different dynasties succeeded each other in power over Delhi.

quiz.say: Which group succeeded the Mamluk Dynasty in Delhi?
quiz.why: The texts show that the Khilji Dynasty followed the Mamluk Dynasty.

wrong.1: This dynasty came much later than the Khilji rulers.
wrong.2: The Lodi Dynasty ruled even later than the Khilji period.
wrong.3: The Gupta Dynasty was from a much earlier time period.

quiz.say: What was a main task of the administration?
quiz.why: The lesson stated that administration involved collecting taxes and managing land.

wrong.1: While they built things, tax collection was a core duty.
wrong.2: Administration was broader than just military training.
wrong.3: This was not mentioned as a primary administrative duty.

quiz.say: If a ruler changes, what is the most likely change in the system?

options.show: The administrative structure stays the same
options.say: The administrative structure stays the same

quiz.why: The core concept is that different dynasties took power in sequence.

wrong.0: New rulers often brought new ways of governing.
wrong.1: Historical records show periods of unrest and change.
wrong.3: Power changes often meant rules and taxes changed too.
